inputs.name: HostedEvidenceService.constructor.transport
inputs.description: Provides the path builder plus evidence and artifact loaders used by this service. Its loader methods are callbacks, and the interface does not constrain their rejection classes.

inputs.name: HostedEvidenceService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Configures HostedReadService with the hosted origin, credential lookup, optional HTTP and authority hooks, optional projection cache, and cache-status callback. It contains callbacks and may contain a ProjectionCacheService instance, so the value has no exact JSON representation.

inputs.name: HostedEvidenceService.evidence.input
inputs.description: Asked combines projectId, entityId, commit, branch, and mode, where mode is current or commit. The service copies it and uses it for the evidence path, read key, transport request, and answer binding.

inputs.name: HostedEvidenceService.artifact.input
inputs.description: Combines the same project and entity revision query with side, recordId, scenarioId, state, evidenceId, viewport, sha256, notesRevision, and evidenceRevision. The service copies it for the artifact path, read key, and transport request; recordId has no service-level format check.

outputs.name: HostedEvidenceService.evidence
outputs.description: Returns the evidence result after the validator checks its shape and binds it to the asked project, entity, branch, mode, and commit. The read may be fresh or use a revalidated offline cache, and its identity is pinned for later artifact reads.

behavior.reason: No evidence records were available for comparison.

outputs.name: HostedEvidenceService.artifact
outputs.description: Returns validated artifact bytes as a Uint8Array with the served media type and requested SHA-256. The validator enforces the 11 MiB limit, hash, and supported media attestation, and a Uint8Array has no exact JSON representation.

errors.name: Hosted evidence identity, access, or integrity failure
errors.description: The implementation and its read validators throw Error for invalid evidence, artifact integrity, credentials, authority changes, or cache identity checks. The injected transport can also reject with its own error class.

errors.name: HostedFailureValidator
errors.description: A classified hosted request failure may reject a read. Offline failures can use a verified cached value, while denied and failed requests are rethrown.

errors.name: Hosted evidence query, revision, or access failure
errors.description: Evidence validation, query binding, current-tip or first-parent checks, and hosted-read credential or cache identity guards can throw Error. Rejections from the injected evidence transport pass through with transport-defined error classes.

errors.description: A classified hosted request failure may reject the evidence read. An offline failure resolves only when an admissible cached value is available; denied and failed requests are rethrown.
